verdict_reason: SE Ranking documents two public REST APIs (Data and Project) with an official reference, API-key auth (plus OAuth 2.1 for its hosted MCP server), and 180+ MCP-exposed tools across SEO data domains. A self-serve 14-day trial provides 100K API credits with no sales contact required, and documented rate limits are generous (10 RPS Data API, 5 RPS Project API). Paid plans are needed after the trial, but that is a production cost gate rather than a credential gate.
open_questions: Input hint https://seranking.com/api returns a 404 page; the real docs live under https://seranking.com/api/data/ and https://seranking.com/api/project/.
No official vendor-maintained SDKs were found; only a Postman collection is documented — confirm whether client libraries exist.
No documented sandbox/test environment beyond the 14-day trial credits; confirm whether a non-production environment exists.
OAuth scopes/permissions for the MCP server's OAuth 2.1 flow are not documented on the fetched pages.
No webhook/event-callback documentation was found; asynchronous Data API exports appear to use polling (confidence low).
No API deprecation/sunset policy was found; only /v1 path versioning is visible in examples.
Community/third-party MCP servers: none found in the supplied MCP registry or GitHub checks.
Whether the 14-day trial requires a credit card or other billing details is not stated in the evidence.
